Connected relaxed phrases and natural adult resonance, noticeably gentler than an excitable cartoon sidekick. No gravelly bass, mature narrator weight, child imitation or forced falsetto. Fluent English at a normal conversational pace, about eight to ten seconds. Clear words and a fully finished final phrase. Clean dry studio sound, one voice, no music or animal noises. An original fictional adult voice, never an imitation of a named actor or character.
